description: This file contains shell functions for verifying and performing firmware upgrades using the RedBoot FIS format, handling image validation and system upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image_redboot_fis
methods.description: Checks if the provided image has the correct magic word indicating a valid RedBoot FIS image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_redboot_fis
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade process for a RedBoot FIS image, extracting and flashing kernel and root filesystem.
